newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH PX50 RALLY FALTERS AS SPT, CEZ FALL BACK.
newsitem.headline: CZECH PX50 RALLY FALTERS AS SPT, CEZ FALL BACK.

text.p: The Czech PX50 index's strong rally, following a sharp depreciation in the Czech crown, all but petered out on Wednesday led by the two most heavily weighted shares.
The PX50 closed up just 0.54 percent to 502.5 after posting its biggest gain in three years on Tuesday.

"Still foreigners are speculating about the not-very-clear position on the capital markets. From their point of view there have not been very big changes in the market or the economy," said Ivan Kusacek of Zivnostenska Banka.
